identitySignals: The organization's own About page (youthcare.com/about/) uses the name 'Youth Care of Utah' and describes a residential treatment center in Draper, Utah, matching the agenda's 'Youth Care of Utah, Draper, UT'
The NATSAP program directory lists 'Youth Care' with 'Youth Care of Utah' as a former/alternate name and the website youthcare.com
The website describes an accredited on-site academic program with certified teachers for grades 6-12, consistent with a Nonpublic, Nonsectarian School special education placement contract

A search result for the California Department of Education school directory lists Pine Ridge Academy at Youth Care of Utah (12595 S Minuteman Dr, Draper, UT) as an out-of-state certified nonpublic school (that page blocks automated fetching and is not cited)
research.notes: The legal name shown on the website is 'Youth Care Treatment Center'; the agenda uses 'Youth Care of Utah', which the site's About page and NATSAP treat as the same program. It is a subsidiary of Acadia Healthcare (for-profit), so no EIN or nonprofit registry entry. No general email is published (contact form only). California Secretary of State and SAM.gov entries were not checked; the registered legal entity name could differ from the facility name.

profile.summary: Youth Care Treatment Center, also known as Youth Care of Utah, is a residential treatment center in Draper, Utah for teenagers with mental health and substance use challenges. It offers therapy, an accredited on-site school program with certified teachers, and day treatment. It is operated as part of Acadia Healthcare.

sources.title: Youth Care Treatment Center - Acadia Healthcare

review.notes: youthcare.com, the Acadia Healthcare location page and the NATSAP listing all describe one Draper, UT residential treatment center with an accredited on-site school, and search results tie the 'Youth Care of Utah' name to the same address, which fits a nonpublic school special-education placement. Every profile field (legal name, address, phone, website, Acadia affiliation) is shown by the cited pages, and the summary is neutral. Two identity signals are overstated (the About page and NATSAP do not actually show 'Youth Care of Utah' as an alternate name), but no profile field depends on them.
